task_description: Frontend UI/UX redesign of the Perpustakaan Digital web app: make the app show LOGIN first and gate the catalog behind authentication; restyle the entire UI to a strictly black-and-white (monochrome) elegant theme; render a self-contained cover image for every book; and replace accidental/implicit actions with explicit buttons plus confirmation steps and clear feedback so the app is easier and more predictable to use. Frontend-only (plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS), no backend contract changes.
